kebab_example: aliyun ga list-listeners --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListListeners

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The transport protocol type of the listener network
parameters.help_zh: 监听网络的传输协议类型
parameters.name: protocol

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance

BackendPorts.description_en: The backend server Server Port information

items.description_en: The backend server Server Port information

FromPort.description_en: The start port of the backend server
FromPort.description_zh: 后端服务器的起始端口

ToPort.description_en: The end port of the backend server
ToPort.description_zh: 后端服务器的结束端口

Type.description_en:
The certificate type.

Currently, only Server (server certificate) is supported
Type.description_zh:
证书类型。

目前，仅支持返回Server（服务端证书）

ClientAffinity.description_en:
The client affinity.

If NONE is returned, client affinity is not maintained. Connections from the same client are not always directed to the same endpoint.

If SOURCE_IP is returned, client affinity is maintained. When a client accesses a stateful application, all requests from the same client are directed to the same endpoint, regardless of the source port and protocol
ClientAffinity.description_zh:
客户端亲和性。

返回为NONE时：不保持客户端亲和性，即不能确保来自同一客户端的连接请求始终定向到同一终端节点。

返回为SOURCE_IP时，保持客户端亲和性。即客户端访问有状态的应用程序时，可以将来自同一客户端的所有请求都定向到同一终端节点，而不考虑源端口和协议

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the listener was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建监听的时间戳。单位：毫秒

HttpVersion.description_en:
The maximum HTTP protocol version. Valid values:
http3: HTTP/3.
http2: HTTP/2.
http1.1: HTTP/1.1.
Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
HttpVersion.description_zh:
HTTP协议的最大版本，取值：
http3：HTTP/3。
http2：HTTP/2。
http1.1：HTTP/1.1。
仅HTTPS监听支持此参数

IdleTimeout.description_en: The idle connection timeout period. Unit: seconds
IdleTimeout.description_zh: 连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒

FromPort.description_en: The start listening port used to receive requests and forward them to endpoints
FromPort.description_zh: 用来接收请求并向终端节点进行转发的起始监听端口

ToPort.description_en: The end listening port used to receive requests and forward them to endpoints
ToPort.description_zh: 用来接收请求并向终端节点进行转发的结束监听端口

Protocol.description_en:
The transport protocol type of the listener.
TCP: TCP protocol.
UDP: UDP protocol.
HTTP: HTTP protocol.
HTTPS: HTTPS protocol
Protocol.description_zh:
监听的网络传输协议类型。
TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
HTTP：HTTP协议。
HTTPS：HTTPS协议

ProxyProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether the client source IP address preservation feature is enabled.

true: The client source IP address preservation feature is enabled. After this feature is enabled, the backend service can view the original IP address of the client.

false: The client source IP address preservation feature is not enabled
ProxyProtocol.description_zh:
是否开启了保持客户端源IP功能。

true：开启了保持客户端源IP功能。开启后，支持后端服务查看客户端的原始IP地址。

false：未开启保持客户端源IP功能

RequestTimeout.description_en:
The HTTP/HTTPS connection request timeout period. Unit: seconds.
This parameter is valid only for listeners whose Protocol (transport protocol type) is HTTP or HTTPS. If the backend server does not return a response within the timeout period, Global Accelerator stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error code to the client
RequestTimeout.description_zh:
HTTP/HTTPS的连接请求超时时间。单位：秒。
仅对Protocol（网络传输协议类型）为HTTP或HTTPS的监听有效。如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，全球加速将放弃等待，并给客户端返回HTTP 504错误码

SecurityPolicyId.description_en:
The security policy instance ID.

tls_cipher_policy_1_0

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, and TLSv1.2.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_1

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.1 and TLSv1.2.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.2.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.2.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, and ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, and ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
SecurityPolicyId.description_zh:
安全策略实例ID。

tls_cipher_policy_1_0

    - 支持的TLS版本：TLSv1.0、TLSv1.1和TLSv1.2。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、AES128-GCM-SHA256、AES256-GCM-SHA384、AES128-SHA256、AES256-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA、AES128-SHA、AES256-SHA和DES-CBC3-SHA。

tls_cipher_policy_1_1

    - 支持的TLS版本： TLSv1.1和TLSv1.2。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、AES128-GCM-SHA256、AES256-GCM-SHA384、AES128-SHA256、AES256-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA、AES128-SHA、AES256-SHA和DES-CBC3-SHA。

tls_cipher_policy_1_2

    - 支持的TLS版本：TLSv1.2。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、AES128-GCM-SHA256、AES256-GCM-SHA384、AES128-SHA256、AES256-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA、AES128-SHA、AES256-SHA和DES-CBC3-SHA。

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict

    - 支持的TLS版本：TLSv1.2。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA和ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA。

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3

    - 支持的TLS版本：TLSv1.2及TLSv1.3。

    - 支持的加密算法套件：TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256、TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384、TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256、TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256、TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA、ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service to which the managed instance belongs.
This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:
true: The instance is managed.
false: The instance is not managed
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：
true：是托管实例。
false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance.
This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True.
When the instance is in a managed state, user operations on the instance are restricted, and certain actions are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: Create an instance.
Update: Update the current instance.
Delete: Delete the current instance.
Associate: Reference or be referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: Unmanage the instance by the user.
CreateChild: Create a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The child resource type. Valid values:
Listener: listener resource.
IpSet: acceleration region resource.
EndpointGroup: endpoint group resource.
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule resource.
Endpoint: endpoint resource.
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping resource of the endpoint group under a custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: endpoint traffic policy resource under a custom routing listener.
This parameter is valid only when Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:
true: The managed policy action is managed. The user cannot perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance.
false: The managed policy action is not managed. The user can perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The status of the listener.

active: Normal. 

init: Initializing.

updating: Being configured.

deleting: Being deleted
State.description_zh:
监听的状态。

active：正常。 

init：初始化。

updating：配置中。

deleting：删除中

Type.description_en:
The routing type of the listener.

Standard: intelligent routing type.

CustomRouting: custom routing type
Type.description_zh:
监听的路由类型。

Standard：智能路由类型。

CustomRouting：自定义路由类型

XForwardedForGaApEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-AP` field is used to retrieve the acceleration area information.
true: yes.
false: no.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForGaApEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-AP`字段获取加速地域信息。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForGaIdEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-ID` header field is used to retrieve the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance ID.
true: yes.
false: no.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForGaIdEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-ID`头字段获取全球加速实例ID。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForPortEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-X-Forward-Port` field is used to retrieve the listener port of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.
true: yes.
false: no.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForPortEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-X-Forward-Port`字段获取全球加速实例的监听端口。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForProtoEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-X-Forward-Proto` field is used to retrieve the listener protocol of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.
true: yes.
false: no.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForProtoEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-X-Forward-Proto`字段获取全球加速实例的监听协议。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XRealIpEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Real-IP` field is used to retrieve the real client IP address.
true: yes.
false: no.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XRealIpEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`X-Real-IP`字段获取真实的客户端IP。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
